title: Overwrite the memory using the master number
body_md: The memory can also be overwritten without operating the operating mode switch. To do this, a programming message as described in the section on programming destination numbers must be sent from the master number to Pro-finder.
prev_context: Before this stands the four-step deletion via the operating mode switch.
next_context: Chapter 3 on the operating states begins on the next page.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 17: equivalent in substance. There are therefore two ways to clear the memory; only the second requires possession of the master number. The message content is not quoted (BLK-005).
